definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is difficult to satisfy, often picky about details or easily displeased.

examples.japanese: {気難|きむずか}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気難|きむずか}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That teacher had a stern expression on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気難|きむずか}しくて、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけ→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧にくい。
examples.english: My grandfather is so fussy that even the family finds it hard to approach him.

notes:
USAGE:
Used almost exclusively to describe people or their expressions/attitudes. {気難|きむずか}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (a stern/difficult expression) is a very common collocation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ describes general difficulty, while {気難|きむずか}しい specifically describes a person's temperament. ⟦{偏屈|へんくつ}→偏屈：11540_henkutsu⟧ (eccentric, stubborn) is stronger and more negative.
